name: no-ai-slop
description: Removes 20+ patterns of AI slop and fixes statistical fingerprints (perplexity, burstiness, cohesion, vocabulary clustering, paragraph symmetry) from any piece of writing while preserving your real voice.

interface.longDescription:
This plugin removes 20+ patterns of AI slop from your writing without flattening your personal voice — and now also fixes the deeper statistical fingerprints that AI detectors notice: low perplexity (default word choice), flat burstiness (all sentences the same length), glass-smooth cohesion (every transition explicit), vocabulary clustering (overused word families), paragraph symmetry (evenly sized paragraphs), and over-explained signposting. Surface slop it removes includes:

Binary contrasts: “It’s not X. It’s Y.”

Throat-clearing openers: “Here’s the thing,” “Let me be clear”

Faux-insight setups: “What nobody tells you,” “The part everyone misses”

Colon reveals: “The best part: it learns.”

Fake-profound endings: “The future isn’t coming. It’s already here.”

...and more.

It preserves real human voice markers (contractions, hedges, asides, natural cadence) without faking imperfection — no added typos, manufactured slang, or invented anecdotes. Those tricks backfire. Real human writing is the goal.

Use it to remove AI slop from your writing or detect named slop patterns in a piece of writing. If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub: https://github.com/petergyang/no-ai-slop
